decisions.reason: Because it is a core upholstery product with its own page and has already been defended once, management is likely to continue backing it and treat any weak sales as not yet clearly structural.

Its commitment is less visible than A's, but as a still-recent decorative fabric close to the established assortment, management would probably keep it and interpret uneven demand as part of the normal collection cycle.

Although prior investment argues for persistence, its lower visibility, more niche wool-blend positioning and weaker fit with the firm's sustainability direction make management more willing now to release resources.
As the newest launch with a page of its own and a strong link to both upholstery and curtain applications, it is likely to receive continued support before any setback is judged permanent.
